# Pinned tagged recipe advancement fixtures

These fourteen JSON files are copied unchanged from Tinkers' Construct
`f4e77d43f39ba1047bf93ae816b7e1beaab514c2`:

https://github.com/SlimeKnights/TinkersConstruct/tree/f4e77d43f39ba1047bf93ae816b7e1beaab514c2/src/generated/resources/data/tconstruct/advancements/recipes

Fixtures are named for their native recipe IDs to avoid collisions between
source `planks`, `congealed` and `duct` filenames. `manifest.json` records
each exact source-relative path and SHA-256 hash. Native adaptations change
recipe IDs, the recipe-unlocked predicate field and legacy item-tag syntax.
Current-world tag membership is resolved at runtime, not embedded in these
advancements.
